# SCI-FRUIT: program obligations and bounded author task

Status: sanitized author-input candidate. This is preparation for a later
explicit launch, not a launch instruction.

## Program charter

The Scientific Contract Library Program establishes scientific meaning before
implementation conformance. A package explains its quantity or transformation,
inputs, outputs, mathematics, assumptions, conventions, validity, uncertainty
and predictive limiting cases. Current implementation cannot establish the
scientifically correct method. Scientific scope and substance require owner
approval; a substantive change after freeze requires a versioned successor.

One canonical scientific authority supplies two views: the scientist-facing
Scientific Rationale and Contract and the Engineering Conformance Specification.
Shared notation, definitions, equations, assumptions, requirements and edge
cases have one LaTeX source. Engineering requirements trace to that science;
the engineering view introduces no independent scientific rule. Documentation
must remain proportional to the science.

## Workflow and roadmap

Recover and classify prior work before deriving. Adopt or cite adequate
authority, abstract approved independent content from mixed sources, and
preserve superseded or excluded material outside the author channel. Do not
repeat an existing derivation merely to recreate context.

The downstream roadmap assigns coordinate truth to ALIGN/AST, upstream
conditioning and calibration to RTC/CAL, timestream transformation to PTC,
mapmaking to MAP/JINC, and ensemble uncertainty to NOI. FRUIT owns feedback,
iteration, learning, restart and lineage. It does not resolve missing
single-pass authority. Later source and observing-mode consumers retain their
scientific interpretations. VAL registers and evaluates owner-defined policy.

The owner-approved scientific-core exception permits this conditional core
before a qualified numerical replacement. It admits no numerical profile and
does not remove later development, qualification or independent-pointing
replication requirements for numerical replacement/performance claims.

The scope, exact packet and launch are distinct approvals. Once the manager
supplies valid exact-packet approval and an explicit launch, the historical
candidate-status prose in these immutable inputs is not a request to pause
again. An author return remains a draft for manager and scientific-owner
review. Independent consistency review and owner freeze follow separately.

## Exact task after authorized launch

Use only the files in the [input manifest](INPUT_MANIFEST_R0.1.md) and subsequent
explicit owner answers. Source identities recorded there are citations, not
permission to open the original sources. Do not inspect the surrounding
repository, implementation, tests, audit or repair records, validation data,
historical experiments, conversation history or external references. The
manager supplies an isolated packet to a fresh implementation-blind author.

Answer the six scientific questions in the [Scope Brief](SCOPE_BRIEF_R0.1.md).
Use the [decisions](SCIENTIFIC_DECISIONS_R0.1.md) and
[inherited boundaries](BOUNDARIES_AND_CONVENTIONS_R0.1.md) as inputs. Explain
the physical meaning first. Develop conditional mathematics and counterexamples
that reveal what a feedback procedure can and cannot claim. A list of fields
or approval gates alone does not complete this task. Do not choose a numerical
policy or rederive the adjacent estimators.

Produce a draft with these canonical source modules:

```text
src/common/notation.tex
src/common/definitions.tex
src/common/equations.tex
src/common/assumptions.tex
src/common/requirements.tex
src/common/edge_cases.tex
src/scientific-rationale.tex
src/engineering-conformance.tex
```

Both views import the same six common modules. Keep stable definition,
equation, requirement and prediction identifiers with a crosswalk to their
assumptions and scientific reasons; do not target an arbitrary count. Include
a short decision log and owner ledger that distinguish approved directions,
conditional author deductions, genuinely open core questions and deferred
numerical choices. Preserve the distinction between contract version v0.1
and document revision r0.1.

Open the rationale with a compact input/output/equation/source/status block.
Keep hashes and internal bookkeeping out of its main narrative. Include a
validity table, uncertainty budget and the meaning of each verification layer.
Distinguish approved facts, known but unsupplied facts, unresolved decisions,
unassessed implementation and unperformed validation. Each owner question
needs a stable ID, owner, state, blocked claim, required decision or evidence,
resolution authority/date and affected definitions or documents.

The rationale should ordinarily keep its main narrative near eight to twelve
pages, with detail in appendices or the engineering view. Compile both PDFs,
check references and crosswalk coverage, render with Poppler, and visually
inspect every page before claiming the document package complete. Document
compilation and mathematical/structural consistency checks are within this
author task; numerical experiments and implementation validation are not.

If a true core ambiguity blocks a derivation, return the precise missing
premise and scientific consequences of the possible answers. Complete
independent portions. Intentionally unselected numerical profiles alone are
not grounds to stop or invent defaults. Hand back the draft, its scope and
assumption checks, rendered views and any exact owner questions. No scientific
freeze, implementation admission or downstream-use approval follows from the
author's completion.
